answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 47241 Country: India Title: Regarding Inherit ency after death of head of the family (Sunni) Question: A Sunni Muslim has expired, leaving behind following legal heir: (1) Wife, (2) Major married son having one minor son and one minor daughter, (3) Major married daughter, (4) Major married daughter, (5) Major Married daughter, (6) Major married daughter. You are requested to intimate the share of each legal heir in percentage, as per Shariah. Answer ID: 47241 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 364/H-314/TH=10/1434) In case the details of the heirs are true, all the property left by the deceased shall be divided into 48 shares after paying due rights preceding inheritance. Out of the total, 6 shares shall go to the wife of deceased person, 14 shares to the son while 7-7 share shall go to each daughter. Details: Wife: 1x06=06 Son: 1x14=14 Daughters: 4x07 =28 Total: 48 Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
